request.summary: Make every research or review strategy automatically leverage repository Inventory during strategy design.
request.intent: Add a read-only machine-index-first Inventory preflight before research or review sheet design.

outputs: Manual correction captured and bounded private strategy update proposed.
validation: Repository Inventory index.json parsed successfully and was searched before source expansion.
The existing Inventory Hook covered post-result ingestion only.
The existing maintenance lookup covered correction-time reflection only.
A separate observer confirmed that ordinary research and review strategy design lacked Inventory consumption.
execution.notes: Inventory lookup selected sigil-maintenance-loop-inventory-first-hardening as relevant prior evidence and preserved the gap between maintenance lookup, strategy preflight, and post-result ingestion.

anti_pattern_hits: strategy design could ignore available repository knowledge
post-result ingestion could be mistaken for pre-sheet evidence retrieval

workflow_gaps.summary: Research and review strategy design had no mandatory Inventory preflight.
workflow_gaps.evidence: The router moved from owner-file reading directly to sheet drafting, while its Inventory Hook only ingested durable results after design.

workflow_gaps.summary: Research and review type owners did not define how Inventory evidence affects lanes or agent inputs.
workflow_gaps.evidence: Neither type skill consumed Inventory matches, exclusions, source references, or lookup gaps during source-corpus, lens, or verifier design.

target_artifact: domainspec-subagents-strategy research and review Inventory preflight
